rationale: Durack Civil is a direct Gold Coast/Brisbane civil contractor seeking an estimator across diverse infrastructure sectors.
Ad requires a minimum of 6 years' civil construction experience with prior mid-tier contractor estimating experience.
Marc's cost-estimate/BOQ coursework gives some discipline overlap, but the years bar is well above his background.
caution: Wants previous estimating experience specifically with a mid-tier QLD/NSW/NT civil contractor.
gaps: No prior civil estimating role experience
mandatory_unmet: "Minimum 6 years' experience in civil construction" (Marc has 11 months site work in the Philippines 2019 to 2020 and no Australian work experience)
title: Civil Estimator
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as an Estimator?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Do you have experience working on civil infrastructure projects?
Have you completed a qualification in construction management?
Have you completed a qualification in civil construction?
